verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no batch or async job-submission API: nothing about uploading request files, creating jobs, polling job status or retrieving results later. What DeepInfra does document is a 'flex' service tier, which sends ordinary Chat Completions requests at a 20% discount in exchange for slower responses. That is a related pricing switch on real-time requests, not asynchronous batch job submission, so it earns no credit under the adjacent-feature rule.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
